note: Meitou only (loss_days): for three days after a squadmate dies, grief and anger outrank the usual cheerful banter on arriving in a new region and after a won fight. /LWFALLEN/ is the name of the squadmate who died last (the helper writes it into the word swap's line; 'them' if it cannot).

say: Doesn't feel right, moving on this soon after /LWFALLEN/.
Keep going. It's what /LWFALLEN/ would say.
Quiet out here. Too quiet without /LWFALLEN/.
I keep turning to say something to /LWFALLEN/.
Doesn't bring /LWFALLEN/ back. Felt good anyway.
More. I want more of them down.
Get up. Get up so I can put you down again.
Not enough. Not nearly enough. Not for /LWFALLEN/.
